package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	jt "github.com/mellowforge/jsontrans-go"
	js "github.com/mellowforge/jsontrans-go/javascript"
	"time"
)

func main() {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	e, err := js.New(ctx, js.Config{GuestMemoryBytes: 8 << 20})
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	defer e.Close()
	healthy, err := e.Compile(ctx, `()=>42`)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct{ name, source string }{{"array-shrink-grow", `()=>{const a=[{a:1},{b:2},{c:3},{d:4},{e:5}];a.length=2;a.length=5;a.push({f:6});return typeof a[3]}`}, {"proxy-size-overflow", `()=>Reflect.ownKeys(new Proxy({}, {ownKeys(){return {length:536870913,0:'x'}}}))`}} {
		p, err := e.Compile(ctx, tc.source)
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		call, stop := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 100*time.Millisecond)
		result, err := p.Eval(call, nil, jt.EvalOptions{})
		stop()
		message := ""
		if err != nil {
			message = err.Error()
			if len(message) > 3000 {
				message = message[:3000]
			}
		}
		recovery, re := healthy.Eval(ctx, nil, jt.EvalOptions{})
		out := map[string]any{"case": tc.name, "result": result, "error": message, "recovery": recovery, "recovery_error": fmt.Sprint(re)}
		data, _ := json.Marshal(out)
		fmt.Println(string(data))
	}
}
